What this says about the round

a grammar. B3 proved it cost the ordered census nothing. D.1.3b·2f made a real host able to start a Carrier at all. B4 made a real Super hold its own Carrier's terminal for the first time. B5 opens that terminal on a person's screen and finds it empty — and the emptiness is not a bug in any of the four, it is the shape of a system that has finished building the pipe and has not yet built the thing that speaks into it.
That is the dogfooding argument, arrived at by running it rather than by predicting it.
